FEAT-ALL.description: Complete modern UI redesign of all project module pages with dramatically different layouts
FEAT-ALL.findings: Build passes cleanly (tsc -b && vite build). All 9 pages were redesigned with dramatic layout changes: split-pane shell with sidebar navigation, gradient mesh hero sections, glassmorphism cards, multi-step wizards, bento grid dashboards, view toggles. Three legacy pages (AlertDeliveryLogsPage, DeadLetterQueuePage, RemoteConfigPage) were fully rewritten from old observe/FillPage patterns to modern pulse design system primitives. AlertRouteWizardPage was also modernized.

verification.summary: npm run build (tsc -b && vite build) passes cleanly with exit code 0. All TypeScript compiles without errors. Vite bundles all modules successfully.
